channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza City police headquarters kills women’s police chief
item.description: An Israeli strike on Gaza City’s police headquarters has killed the women’s police chief and several officers.

item.title: USS Lincoln woes highlight US Navy limits in prolonged Iran war: Experts
item.description: Reports of dire conditions underscore supply challenges, questions of US plans going forward, experts say.

item.title: What’s behind Israel’s latest attack on Syria?
item.description: US envoy warns Israel's strike could have sparked direct confrontation with Turkish forces.

item.title: Seven people, mostly foreign tourists, killed in helicopter crash in Kenya
item.description: Ecuador's intelligence chief Michele Sensi-Contugi and NBCUniversal journalist Jose Suarez are among the dead.

item.title: Iran’s hardline parliament raises concerns with ‘foreign infiltration’ plan
item.description: Citizens and entities would have to seek authorisation to contact universities or talk to foreign media.

item.title: NATO ‘prepared’ to defend allies amid report of Iranian strike plans
item.description: NATO says it will 'do what is necessary' amid media report Iran considered strikes against US targets in Europe.

item.title: Hamas condemns ‘new war crime’ as Israel kills 10 in crowded Gaza hubs
item.description: Israeli air strikes on Gaza kill 10 Palestinians, targeting police headquarters and a refugee camp in separate attacks.

item.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
item.description: The five-year old Gaza girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.

item.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
item.description: Israeli plans to build on the area east of Jerusalem - which would divide the occupied West Bank in two - have long been internationally condemned.

item.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
item.description: Michele Sensi-Contugi, and his wife Stephany Hollihan among the seven people killed in the crash.
